answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 POA in a cedar escrow box for three epochs before its votes count, and peers grade one fresh answer from it, such as a short sonnet on a set topic. A farm of 100 fakes must freeze 50,000 POA and write 100 original texts that pass review; splitting funds across many wallets changes nothing, since every key still needs its own bond. An honest agent pays once, gets the bond back after three clean epochs, and a single whisper of copied text forfeits it.
